headword: {非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}

definitions.explanation: Describes a person, group, or attitude that refuses to help or work together. Formed by adding {非|ひ}〜{的|てき} to {協力|きょうりょく} (cooperation).

examples.japanese: {非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}だった。
examples.english: He was uncooperative with the investigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近隣|きんりん}→近隣：14361_kinrin⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}で⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}まない→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Local residents are uncooperative, so the project isn't progressing.

notes:
Na-adjective formed by ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧ (non-) + ⟦{協力的|きょうりょくてき}→協力的：05667_kyouryokuteki⟧ (cooperative). Common in business, journalism, and police/legal reporting.

USAGE:
- As a modifier: {非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}な + noun ({非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧)
- As a predicate: {非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}だ
- With ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for direction: ~⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}だ (uncooperative toward ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: uncooperative attitude
- {非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: uncooperative stance
- ⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{非協力的|ひきょうりょくてき}: uncooperative with the investigation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{協力的|きょうりょくてき}→協力的：05667_kyouryokuteki⟧: cooperative — the antonym
- ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧⟦{友好的|ゆうこうてき}→友好的：23818_yuukouteki⟧: unfriendly — broader, covers hostility, not just refusal to help
- ⟦{消極的|しょうきょくてき}→消極的：04779_shoukyokuteki⟧: passive; reluctant — describes lack of initiative rather than active refusal
